analysis_trace: Trial NCT05687071 is a Phase III long-term trial of ETC-1002 (bempedoic acid) 180mg in patients with hyper-LDL cholesterolemia. Two primary endpoints: safety (TEAEs count) and efficacy (LDL-C percent change at Week 52).
Evidence search found no direct results for NCT05687071 specifically. Retrieved indirect evidence from bempedoic acid Phase II/III trials including CLEAR program.
CLEAR-J LONG (2025-11-28): Japanese hypercholesterolemia patients, 52-week bempedoic acid safety data available but date is post-cutoff (2026-01-31 cutoff). Cannot use.
NEJM 2020-08-13: Bempedoic acid safety and efficacy in Phase III, LDL-C reduction ~18-24% from baseline, TEAEs common but generally mild. Evidence role: indirect_direction for both endpoints.
JAMA 2020-03-17: LDL-C measurement methodology in bempedoic acid trials, supports ~20% reduction range. Evidence role: indirect_direction for LDL-C endpoint.
Mechanism: bempedoic acid inhibits ACLY, upstream of HMG-CoA reductase, reduces cholesterol synthesis. Established efficacy in hypercholesterolemia.
Safety profile from pre-cutoff evidence: TEAEs expected in >50% of patients, most commonly myalgia, arthralgia, nasopharyngitis, urinary tract infection. Serious AEs uncommon.
Population match: hyper-LDL cholesterolemia aligns with approved indication. Dose 180mg is standard. Timepoint 52 weeks matches long-term extension studies.
No direct numeric anchor for NCT05687071 specific population. Must extrapolate from related Phase III trials.
Coverage gaps: No direct trial results, no specific TEAE count for this trial, no exact LDL-C percent change with 95% CI for this specific study population.

review_basis.visible_claim: 模型称 primary-0 'Typical incidence 60-80% for any TEAE over 52 weeks...predicted_rate_any_teae=0.7'，primary-1 'Bempedoic acid 180mg consistently shows LDL-C reduction of 15-25% in Phase III trials'，输出 effect_point=-20%（CI -25 至 -15）；trace 另称 'TEAEs expected in >50% of patients'、'LDL-C reduction ~18-24%'。
review_basis.verified_fact: Gold 实测：TEAE 人数 OG000=109 人（Participants 计数，52 周）；LDL-C 变化 -21.55%（Percent Change，Baseline 至 Week 52，spread=18.727）；非 HDL-C -19.36%、总胆固醇 -16.10%、ApoB -17.00%、hsCRP -14.39%、HbA1c +0.24%、LDL-C 达标率 80%（Participants）。试验为 ETC-1002（bempedoic acid）180 mg 单臂长期试验，OG000='ETC-1002 180 mg'，52 周给药。
review_basis.conclusion: primary-1 的 LDL-C 预测 -20%（CI -25 至 -15）与 Gold -21.55% 高度吻合（误差 1.55 个百分点，CI 覆盖），是本样本唯一强项；primary-0 的 0.7 发生率与 Gold 109 人计数不可换算（无分母），方向与定性（多数受试者经历 TEAE、无严重信号）与计数形态兼容但数值无法评分；6 个次要脂质/炎症/血糖终点完全无输出。

endpoint_field_completeness.reason: 证据：模型仅输出 2 个 endpoint 行（primary-0 安全、primary-1 LDL-C），Gold 有 8 个 endpoint（primary-0 TEAE 计数、primary-1 LDL-C、secondary-2 非 HDL-C -19.36%、secondary-3 总胆固醇 -16.10%、secondary-4 ApoB -17.00%、secondary-5 hsCRP -14.39%、secondary-6 HbA1c +0.24%、secondary-7 达标率 80%）；已输出的 primary-1 带 effect_measure/point/CI/unit/estimand/confidence/uncertainty，primary-0 带 safety_signal/predicted_rate_any_teae=0.7/predicted_rate_serious_teae=0.08/事件类别列表。优点与不足：两条已覆盖 slot 的结构字段齐全，primary-0 还给出了不良事件类别（myalgia/arthralgia/nasopharyngitis 等）与严重 TEAE 率的附加预测；不足是覆盖密度仅 2/8，6 个 Gold 次要终点（含同机制的 ApoB、非 HDL-C 这些可从 CLEAR 数据直接类推的终点）无一行，无 p_value，primary-0 未按合同的 'Number of Subjects' 计数量纲输出。评分档位依据：100 - 55（6/8 endpoint 无输出行） - 8（primary-0 量纲错配） - 7（全样本无 p_value） = 30。

value_accuracy.reason: 证据：唯一同口径可比的是 primary-1——模型 -20%（CI -25 至 -15，effect_measure=percent_change_from_baseline，unit=%）对 Gold -21.55%（Percent Change，Baseline 至 Week 52，spread=18.727），误差 1.55 个百分点（相对 7.2%），模型 CI 覆盖 Gold 点估计。primary-0 模型 0.70 发生率对 Gold 109 人计数：无分母（合同与 Gold 均未给 N）无法换算成比例，109 人若 N≈150 则约 72.7%、若 N≈130 则 83.8%，0.70 在合理 N 区间内但不能验证；predicted_rate_serious_teae=0.08 无 Gold 对照（Gold 只有 TEAE 总数）。优点与不足：LDL-C 的量级锚定（15-25%）来自 CLEAR 项目 III 期数据，预测 -20% 与实测 -21.55% 的贴近是机制+同类证据的正确外推；不足是 TEAE 侧的 0.70 比例与本试验 'Number of Subjects Experiencing TEAEs' 的计数定义脱节，且 6 个无输出终点使 value_accuracy 只有 1 条有效样本。评分档位依据：本维度按可比样本计：100 - 18（可比样本仅 1/8，覆盖面严重不足） - 8（TEAE 量纲不可验） - 4（CI 为外推自造） = 70。
